# @three-ws/agenc

> Client for the AgenC agent-coordination protocol on Solana — discover tasks, read task status + lifecycle, and look up the agent registry in one import.

- Repository: https://github.com/nirholas/agenc
- Documentation: https://nirholas.github.io/agenc/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@three-ws/agenc
- License: Apache-2.0
- Part of three.ws: https://three.ws

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc/blob/main/README.md): install, usage and full API reference
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/agenc/llms-full.txt): the entire README as plain text
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc/blob/main/AGENTS.md): conventions for coding agents
- [Security policy](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/nirholas/agenc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
